_readme: Thought of the Day. One quote per day, chosen deterministically from the date. 'author' is only set when the attribution is well documented; otherwise it is null. Add, remove or reorder freely.

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Very little is needed to make a happy life.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Such as are your habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of your mind.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The best revenge is not to be like your enemy.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: If you seek tranquility, do less.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Loss is nothing else but change, and change is Nature's delight.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: He suffers more than necessary, who suffers before it is necessary.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: If a man knows not to which port he sails, no wind is favorable.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: No man was ever wise by chance.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the opinions about things.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: No great thing is created suddenly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Carpe diem.
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.text: Character is destiny.
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.text: No man ever steps in the same river twice.
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.text: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.text: Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.text: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: Amor fati. Love your fate.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
quotes.author: Søren Kierkegaard

quotes.text: All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone.
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.text: Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms, to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
quotes.author: Viktor E. Frankl

quotes.text: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
quotes.author: Viktor E. Frankl

quotes.text: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.text: Discipline equals freedom.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.text: Pressure is a privilege.
quotes.author: Billie Jean King

quotes.text: Hard choices, easy life. Easy choices, hard life.
quotes.author: Jerzy Gregorek

quotes.text: Be water, my friend.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: Absorb what is useful, discard what is useless, add what is specifically your own.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali

quotes.text: I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
quotes.author: Michael Jordan

quotes.text: Everybody has a plan until they get punched in the mouth.
quotes.author: Mike Tyson

quotes.text: Be quick, but don't hurry.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.text: Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.text: The score takes care of itself.
quotes.author: Bill Walsh

quotes.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe

quotes.text: Genius is one percent inspiration, ninety-nine percent perspiration.
quotes.author: Thomas Edison

quotes.text: Inspiration is for amateurs. The rest of us just show up and get to work.
quotes.author: Chuck Close

quotes.text: Chance favors only the prepared mind.
quotes.author: Louis Pasteur

quotes.text: Less, but better.
quotes.author: Dieter Rams

quotes.text: Real artists ship.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: We are stubborn on vision. We are flexible on details.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: The credit belongs to the man who is actually in the arena.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Someone's sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget rule No. 1.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: The first rule of compounding is to never interrupt it unnecessarily.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: Play long-term games with long-term people.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Earn with your mind, not your time.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Either write something worth reading or do something worth writing.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: The best way out is always through.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.text: I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott

quotes.text: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.text: Not all those who wander are lost.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quotes.text: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quotes.text: The world breaks everyone and afterward many are strong at the broken places.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.text: Courage is grace under pressure.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.text: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.text: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.text: We may encounter many defeats but we must not be defeated.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
quotes.author: Dan Millman

quotes.text: In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: The mountains are calling and I must go.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: There is no joy without pain.
Memento mori.
Festina lente. Make haste slowly.
Per aspera ad astra. Through hardship to the stars.
Dum spiro, spero. While I breathe, I hope.
Fortune favors the bold.
Know thyself.
Nothing in excess.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
Well begun is half done.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Measure twice, cut once.
Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
Hope is not a strategy.
Choose the harder right over the easier wrong.
Done is better than perfect.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Calm is a superpower.
Do the hard thing first.
Be so consistent it looks like talent.
Quiet work. Loud results.
Earn your rest.
Hold the standard when no one is watching.
The work is the reward.
Focus is the art of saying no.
Discomfort is the price of admission.
Your future self is watching.
Feelings follow action.
Consistency beats intensity.
Nobody is coming. Build it yourself.
Stay patient. Trust the compounding.
Clarity comes from doing.
Strong body, clear mind.
Ambition, with patience.
Be the calm in the room.
Respect the process.
Train the mind like you train the body.
Protect your attention.
Excellence is quiet.
Rest if you must, but never quit.
Become undeniable.
Build in silence.
Short-term pain, long-term gain.
The best investment is in yourself.
Read more. Talk less. Decide faster.
Let the work speak.
No zero days.
Every master was once a beginner.
Do less, but do it better.
Breathe. Then decide.
Small hinges swing big doors.
True nobility is being superior to your former self.
Make today count, then let it go.
